none: PAS NLM-B54456: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Constantinopolis commemorative issue of 330-340, Reeve period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted bust of Constantinopolis left. Obverse inscription: [CONSTANTINOPOLIS]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left on prow, shield right. In exergue: TRS. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.1mm, Weight: 1.62gms, die axis: 12
